page.layout: One page of text, one column. The dedication paragraph runs at full width at the top. Below it are the dateline (Exon: Coll: ...), the right-aligned closing lines and the printer's name, all set as short lines. The page number is at the bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: (conculcatis hujus mundi mellitis Illecebris) Obedientia, Abstinentia & Iu-ramenti Religio, ad gustum Tuum Nobiliorem faciant; satis habet is, qui unà cum hac grati Animi Tessera Seipsum dicat, dedicatq;

page.notes: The long s is printed as s and is transcribed as s. The printed hyphen in "Iu-ramenti" is kept at the line end. The small-capital name is set in capitals. The first paragraph starts from the previous page.
